story_title: Barley Yield Analysis: Varieties, Sites, and Time
story_subtitle: Insights into barley yield performance across different varieties, sites, and years

story_pieces.narration: Trebi and Wisconsin No. 38 consistently showed the highest average yields across all sites, outperforming other varieties in both 1931 and 1932.
story_pieces.question: Which barley varieties had the highest average yields across all sites and years?

story_pieces.narration: Yields fluctuated significantly between 1931 and 1932, with some varieties showing a decline and others demonstrating improvement over the two years.
story_pieces.question: How did barley yields change between 1931 and 1932 for different varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (year vs. yield, grouped by variety)

story_pieces.narration: Waseca and University Farm were the top-performing sites for most varieties, often recording higher yields compared to other locations.
story_pieces.question: Which sites had the highest average yields across all varieties and years?

story_pieces.narration: Variability in yields was most pronounced in Grand Rapids and Duluth, where fluctuations across varieties were greater compared to other sites.
story_pieces.question: Which sites exhibited the highest variability in barley yields across varieties?

story_pieces.narration: Wisconsin No. 38 and Trebi achieved the highest individual yields in specific sites, highlighting site-specific success stories for these varieties.
story_pieces.question: Which varieties achieved the highest yields in specific sites, and how do they compare across locations?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (site vs. yield, grouped by variety)
